verdict.rationale: Apple documents public developer APIs (Metal 4 Tensor APIs for Neural Accelerators, Core ML, Foundation Models framework) that let developers program the M5's AI hardware, but this is a hardware/developer-framework API, not an agentic API meant for an 'AI-native user' to drive the product directly. missing for 10: no evidence of an agent-facing/programmatic control API for the chip itself, no llms.txt or agent-oriented API docs (llms.txt probe returned 404), no independent corroboration of AI agents actually invoking these APIs.
